scope_of_deliverables.quote: Scope of Work RFP CMH26-85 – Learning Management System (LMS) Data Migration • Migration of users, organization hierarchy. • Vendor to provide mapping templates, test plan, and reconciliation process. Testing • SIT (system/integration testing) and UAT with City test scripts; defect triage; performance testing; accessibility verification. Training & Change Management • Admin training (advanced and day-to-day), instructor training, manager training, and learner quick guides. • Training materials in editable formats (PowerPoint/Word/PDF); short video tutorials preferred. Go-Live & Hypercare • Cutover plan, rollback criteria, and communication plan. • Hypercare for at least 30 days post go-live with defined response/resolution targets. 4) Support & SLAs Includes support channels, SLA response/resolution timelines, maintenance windows, release schedules. 5) Deliverables & Milestones Covers project plan, design, sandbox configuration, migration, UAT, training, go-live, and hypercare. 6) Roles & Responsibilities
scope_of_deliverables.value: The City of Medicine Hat is seeking proposals for a Learning Management System (LMS) that includes data migration, testing, training, go-live support, and ongoing service and support. The deliverables include migration of users and organization hierarchy, system and integration testing, training for various roles, and hypercare support post go-live.

evaluation_criteria.quote:
G. RATED CRITERIA
The following sets out the categories, weightings, and descriptions of the rated criteria of the RFP. Proponents who do not meet a minimum threshold score for a category will not proceed to the next stage of the evaluation process.
Product Demonstration:
The evaluation will be conducted in two stages. In Stage 1, all proposals will be evaluated against the rated criteria for a subtotal of 100 points, including a technical component worth 50 points. Proponents must achieve a minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points to meet the technical threshold.
The top-ranked proponents that meet the technical threshold, up to a maximum of six, may be invited to participate in Stage 2, at the City’s discretion. Stage 2 will consist of a product demonstration.
Stage 2 demonstrations will be scored out of 30 points and added to the Stage 1 scores to determine the final ranking (Total = 130 points).
